description: The XFCE desktop, logged in as the box user at start: the image and its boxes get a screen, shown with box view

steps.name: XFCE, its terminal, the LightDM login manager and the X server, without recommended packages except the SVG image loader its wallpaper and icons need, and xclip for the box window's clipboard buttons
steps.run: apt-get -q -y update && apt-get -q -y --no-install-recommends install xfce4 xfce4-terminal xfdesktop4-data lightdm lightdm-gtk-greeter xserver-xorg-core xserver-xorg-input-libinput dbus-x11 librsvg2-common xclip

steps.name: The box user logged in to XFCE at start, with no password
The screen never blanks
steps.run: mkdir -p /etc/X11/xorg.conf.d && printf '%s\n' 'Section "ServerFlags"' '    Option "BlankTime" "0"' '    Option "StandbyTime" "0"' '    Option "SuspendTime" "0"' '    Option "OffTime" "0"' 'EndSection' > /etc/X11/xorg.conf.d/50-agent-vm.conf

steps.name: The screen takes the size an interactive box view window gives the display, which X does not by itself: the program that applies it
That program starts with the XFCE session
The desktop starts with the system
steps.run: systemctl enable lightdm && systemctl set-default graphical.target

update.name: The SVG image loader, for an image built before the recipe installed it
update.run: if [ "$(dpkg-query -W -f '${db:Status-Status}' librsvg2-common 2> /dev/null)" = installed ]; then echo 'the SVG image loader is installed'; else apt-get -q -y update && apt-get -q -y --no-install-recommends install librsvg2-common; fi

update.name: The program that gives the screen the size of an interactive box view window, for an image built before the recipe had it
That program starts with the XFCE session
xclip, which the box window's clipboard buttons use, for an image built before the recipe installed it
update.run: if command -v xclip > /dev/null; then echo 'xclip is installed'; else apt-get -q -y update && apt-get -q -y --no-install-recommends install xclip; fi

checks: [ "$(systemctl is-enabled lightdm)" = enabled ] && echo 'LightDM starts with the system'
[ "$(systemctl get-default)" = graphical.target ] && echo 'the system starts to graphical.target'
grep -qx "autologin-user=$(id -un)" /etc/lightdm/lightdm.conf.d/50-agent-vm.conf && echo "$(id -un) is logged in at start"
command -v xfce4-session > /dev/null && command -v Xorg > /dev/null && echo 'XFCE and the X server are installed'
[ "$(dpkg-query -W -f '${db:Status-Status}' librsvg2-common)" = installed ] && echo 'the wallpaper and the icons, which are SVG files, can be drawn'

[ -x /usr/local/libexec/agent-vm-fit-display ] && [ -x /usr/bin/udevadm ] && [ -x /usr/bin/xrandr ] && grep -qx 'Exec=/usr/local/libexec/agent-vm-fit-display' /etc/xdg/autostart/agent-vm-fit-display.desktop && echo 'the screen takes the size of an interactive box view window'
command -v xclip > /dev/null && echo 'the box window can copy text to and from the clipboard (xclip)'
